2608.24807.title: Automatic Model Card Generation Using an LLM
2608.24807.paper_summary: Model cards are structured documents that summarize key information about machine learning models to improve transparency, usability, and accountability. However, they often lack a consistent structure, and many models provide no model cards, making comparison and interpretation difficult. This paper presents two contributions. First, we propose MCTidy, an LLM-based approach that reorganizes existing model cards into a standardized template to improve clarity and comparability. Second, we introduce MCGenie, an LLM-based system that generates model cards directly from model repository data. We apply MCTidy to 48 Hugging Face model cards and evaluate information retention, section alignment, hallucination, and stability. Our findings show high information retention with minimal textual loss, accurate section assignment, rare hallucinations primarily in descriptive sections, and strong stability across runs. We assess MCGenie by generating model cards for the same 48 models and assessing semantic similarity, factual correctness, and sensitivity to input resources. The generated model cards achieved high semantic similarity (mean around 0.9); over half were fully correct, and most remaining errors were minor. Generation quality depended strongly on the availability of supporting resources, particularly associated papers. Overall, our findings demonstrate the potential of LLM-based methods to enable scalable, standardized model card documentation.
2608.24807.paper_summary_zh: 模型卡是結構化的文件，總結了有關機器學習模型的關鍵信息，以提高透明度、可用性和問責性。<lb/>然而，它們通常缺乏一致的結構，許多模型沒有提供模型卡，這使得比較和解釋變得困難。<lb/>本文提出了兩項貢獻。<lb/>首先，我們提出了MCTidy，一種基於LLM的方法，將現有的模型卡重新組織為標準化模板，以提高清晰度和可比性。<lb/>其次，我們介紹了MCGenie，一種基於LLM的系統，能夠直接從模型庫數據生成模型卡。<lb/>我們將MCTidy應用於48個Hugging Face模型卡，並評估信息保留、部分對齊、幻覺和穩定性。<lb/>我們的研究結果顯示信息保留率高，文本損失最小，部分分配準確，幻覺現象主要出現在描述性部分且相對少見，並且在多次運行中穩定性強。<lb/>我們通過為同樣的48個模型生成模型卡來評估MCGenie，並評估語義相似性、事實正確性和對輸入資源的敏感性。<lb/>生成的模型卡實現了高語義相似性（平均約為0.9）；超過一半的模型卡完全正確，其餘大多數錯誤為小錯誤。<lb/>生成質量在很大程度上取決於支持資源的可用性，特別是相關論文。<lb/>總體而言，我們的研究結果展示了基於LLM的方法在促進可擴展、標準化模型卡文檔方面的潛力。
